steps.content: Dragonberg's top hall is shrouded by a mysterious energy. An enormous, intricate mechanical clock floats in the air, while the maniac who's rumored to have let the Ice Plague into the Isle of Sky stands right before it.
Darkness veils Cyrus's face. A huge two-headed beast crouches beside him, guarding him like a loyal pet dog. This appears to be the Dragon of Calamity the castellan has told you about.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content: Cyrus, hand over the <color=#fb9259>power source</color> that controls the Ice Plague!
The maniac's cold, hysterical gaze passes over the crew. He seems well-adapted to this kind of scenario.

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: You're a fraud who claims to be the Chosen One. Do you intend to challenge the marvelous Cyrus?
The man waves his hand, and the two-headed dragon who's half machinery and half flesh follows his gesture and soars into the sky, casting an enormous shadow over you all.

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: Weaklings, tremble under the power of the Dragon of Genesis!
